slides.title: Choose the Ministry First. Then Lead the Work.
slides.lead:
Calling comes before coordination. 
Service is not a task—it is a response to God’s call.

slides.title: Serve with Conviction, Not Convenience
slides.lead:
True service costs something. 
But obedience to God produces eternal impact.

slides.title: A Disciple Serves Before He Leads
slides.lead: Jesus called servants, not spectators. Follow closely—serve faithfully.

slides.title: Lead by Serving. Serve by Obeying.
slides.lead:
Authority in God’s kingdom flows from humility. 
The greatest are those who serve.

slides.title: Obedience Unlocks the Work of God
slides.lead: Every act of service is a step of faith. God moves through those who obey.

slides.title: Not My Will, But Yours Be Done
slides.lead:
A servant’s life is not self-directed.
It is fully surrendered to God’s purpose.
